name: sythm-monorepo
description: Sythm — COBOL-inspired live coding music language and Xcode-style web IDE

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @sythm/core build && pnpm --filter @sythm/backend build && pnpm --filter @sythm/frontend build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @sythm/core test && pnpm --filter @sythm/backend test && pnpm --filter @sythm/frontend test
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
